The decisive mistake was in Step 1. The Tizin_Translation_Expert treated "Maktay" as a normal transitive verb, with "I" as the subject and "apples" as the direct object. The rules say "Maktay" means "is pleasing to," so the person doing the liking is the object (accusative "Mato") and the liked thing is the subject (nominative "Apple"). The correct order is Verb, Object, Subject: "Maktay Mato Apple." The expert's "Maktay Zapple Pa" reversed the roles and was then confirmed by the later agents without re-checking the grammar.
